title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2610.26941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. This article presents a systematic overview of LLM-driven industrial agents. First, we analyze five key challenges and discuss the concept and core characteristics of industrial agents. We then establish a unified taxonomy covering application scenarios, embodiment forms, and five capability levels. Next, we propose a four-layer system architecture and detail its core modules and operational mechanisms for closed-loop task execution. translated_title: 工业智能体AI：面向智能制造的大语言模型驱动的新一代智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在使智能体超越预定义的工作流程，走向自主规划与执行，为智能制造创造新的机遇。然而，动态环境、复杂的物理约束以及严苛的可靠性要求，阻碍了通用智能体在智能制造中的直接部署。本文对LLM驱动的工业智能体进行了系统性综述。首先，我们分析了五大关键挑战，并讨论了工业智能体的概念与核心特征。随后，我们建立了涵盖应用场景、具身形式和五个能力层级的统一分类体系。接着，我们提出了一种四层系统架构，并详细阐述了其核心模块与闭环任务执行的运行机制。最后，我们回顾了覆盖工业全生命周期的代表性应用，并展望了未来的研究方向。本文为该领域提供了一个结构化的……
tldr: 本文系统综述了LLM驱动的工业智能体，针对智能制造中的动态环境、物理约束与可靠性挑战，提出涵盖应用场景、具身形式与五级能力的统一分类体系以及支持闭环任务执行的四层系统架构。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys LLM-driven industrial agents for smart manufacturing, proposing a unified taxonomy of application scenarios, embodiment forms, and capability levels, along with a four-layer architecture enabling closed-loop task execution.
